snippet.title: Walking Steel // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3108380/Walking_Steel/

Fight epic tank battles, upgrade your vehicles and survive in dangerous conditions. Explore the world, find resources and fight enemies to become the best tanker. Join "Walking Steel" and prove your strength and tactics on the battlefield!

Developed by
Phantom Zero
